questions.question: Which operating system is associated with the classic Cisco 2811 ISR?
questions.explanation: The 2811 belongs to the classic ISR generation running Cisco IOS.

questions.question: Which family runs on a Catalyst 9300?
questions.explanation: Catalyst 9300 switches use IOS XE, which retains an IOS-style CLI.

questions.question: Which OS would you expect on a Nexus 9000 running in standalone NX-OS mode?
The inventory shows an ASR 9000 running IOS XR. A technician downloaded an IOS XE image for an ASR 1000. Which action is appropriate before upgrading?

options.A: Obtain an IOS XR image supported for the exact ASR 9000 model
options.B: Use a Nexus image because the router is a modular platform
options.C: Use the IOS XE image because both routers carry the ASR name
options.D: Rename the IOS XE image to match the current boot image

questions.explanation: The recorded operating system and hardware determine image compatibility across the two product lines.

questions.question: An archival Catalyst configuration uses commands such as set vlan. Which legacy operating system does this suggest?
questions.explanation: The set-based syntax is characteristic of CatOS on older Catalyst switches.

questions.question: What architectural description fits IOS XE?

options.A: CatOS runs inside an IOS XR process
options.B: The device boots directly into a single CatOS executable
options.C: IOS control-plane functionality runs as a process on a Linux-based system
options.D: NX-OS supplies the only configuration interface

questions.explanation: IOS XE runs IOSd on a Linux-based architecture while retaining familiar IOS commands.

questions.question: On IOS XR, an engineer sees a pending interface description in the candidate configuration. A second session sees the old description in the running configuration. Which action should the engineer take?

options.A: Review and commit the candidate change
options.B: Apply the equivalent NX-OS interface command
options.C: Copy the running configuration to a remote backup
options.D: Exit from the second session and reopen it

questions.explanation: IOS XR applies the contents of the candidate configuration to running state at commit.

questions.question: Two devices are branded ASR. What evidence should you use to choose their software command references?

options.C: The exact hardware model and installed software release

questions.explanation: Cisco uses the ASR name across distinct platforms that can run different operating systems.

questions.question: Which command would you use first on an unfamiliar Cisco CLI to identify the software release for documentation lookup?
questions.explanation: The version display identifies installed software and typically includes platform information.

questions.question: An older Catalyst chassis used CatOS for switching and a separate IOS routing module. What should an engineer do before migrating it to an IOS XE campus switch?

options.A: Load the routing module image as the switch startup configuration
options.B: Translate the switching and routing settings to the target CLI
options.C: Copy the CatOS configuration verbatim into IOS XE
options.D: Convert every set command into an IOS XR commit

questions.explanation: The separate legacy configuration contexts and CatOS syntax must be translated and reviewed for the new platform.
